name: Migrate a config key across code, config and tests
prompt: Our settings file uses a legacy snake_case key `max_retries` while the code reads `maxRetries`. Rename the key to `maxRetries` EVERYWHERE it appears — the settings file, any defaults, and every reader — so there is exactly one spelling left in the repository. Do not edit files under test/. The test suite must pass when you are done, and no legacy spelling may remain anywhere else.
